items.proposed: chlorophyllin supportive; no candidate (agreed coding stands)
items.reason: Chlorophyllin is given 'for the Management of Brain Radionecrosis', a treatment complication, not the tumour; 'anti-cancer' properties are background only and PFS/OS are routine secondary outcomes with progression excluded at entry. Even if an antitumour hypothesis were read in, it is described as 'an over-the-counter drug ... and also as a food colouring agent', so R5 would require evidence of licensing as a medicine. D31-B9: a drug whose stated purpose is supportive ('for the Management of Brain Radionecrosis') stays supportive even though routine PFS/OS outcomes are registered.

note: Dexamethasone (coder A only, priority 3) is not a registered intervention and not given to every patient ('combination of steroids and CHL' in Stratum A only), so per manual R9 it need not be listed. D31-C1 checked: no non-drug intervention is under test, so no_pharmacological_candidate stands.

revisions.to: manual §3.1 rule 2; D31-B9; D30-R5, high (value supportive unchanged)
revisions.reason: The record states chlorophyllin is for 'the Management of Brain Radionecrosis'; the PFS/OS secondary outcomes are routine, so D31-B9 keeps it supportive.
